[d0486] config | scheduler.queue_capacity | version 4.x
# `scheduler.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the scheduler that releases delayed messages at their due time.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10000` |
| Available since | 1.0 |
| Component | scheduler |
| Unit | tasks |

## Tuning advice

Measure before you tune. Increase or decrease `scheduler.queue_capacity` in small steps and observe the effect for at least one day.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[scheduler]
queue_capacity = 10000
```

---

[d0872] config | snapshotter.queue_capacity (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `snapshotter.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1000` |
| Available since | 1.1 |
| Component | snapshotter |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `snapshotter.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the snapshotter that creates point-in-time backups of queues, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[snapshotter]
queue_capacity = 1000
```

---

[d0175] config | partitioner.queue_capacity (PaderQueue 3.x) | version 3.x
# `partitioner.queue_capacity` (PaderQueue 3.x)

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 3.x.

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the partitioner that decides into which partition a message is written.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `1000` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | partitioner |
| Unit | tasks |

## Notes

Changes to `partitioner.queue_capacity` take effect after restarting the node. In clusters, use the same value on all nodes.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[partitioner]
queue_capacity = 1000
```

# `retention.queue_capacity`

> Configuration reference for PaderQueue 4.x (current).

Maximum number of pending tasks in the internal work queue of the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period.

| Property | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | integer |
| Default | `10000` |
| Available since | 1.2 |
| Component | retention |
| Unit | tasks |

## When to change it

The default works for most deployments. Change `retention.queue_capacity` only if you observe problems with the retention manager that deletes messages older than the retention period, for example in the metrics dashboard.

Set it in `paderqueue.toml`:

```toml
[retention]
queue_capacity = 10000
```
